description: List every workspace this account can act in, with its id and the caller's role. Call this FIRST when more than one may exist: every other tool takes an optional workspaceId, and once there are several it becomes required — the connected social accounts, media library, posting queue and analytics are all per workspace. When there is more than one, ASK THE USER which workspace to post to rather than choosing for them.
name: list_workspaces
title: List workspaces
